comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: If you are rich with your ship parts, do this mission. You get 10 heavy galleons rapidly shooting incendiary at you in each encounter. You need to sink 20 at total that makes you have to do battle at least twice. My 90 dura brand new carronades were down to 26 dura after 2 bloody battles. This mission is highly NOT recommended for solo.
